facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jack went inside the castle. He took some gold. A giant found him. The giant was angry.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jack entered the enormous castle on top of the clouds. Everything inside was huge, built for a giant. Jack saw gold coins on the table and took some. Suddenly, a giant stomped into the room. The giant was angry and shouted with a booming voice. Jack quickly hid under the giant table in fear.
